purpose: Authoritative explicit observations for individually scoped manual and software checks.
authority: Explicit user observations; generated Markdown is a read-only view.
state_policy: Unverified, passed, failed, stale; not applicable is an explicit separate declaration.
rotation_policy: Human game checks are required only at 0° CCW. Supported construction orientations and software rotation checks retain their separate scope; these human cases do not establish observations at the other orientations.
environment_policy: Every result applies only to its recorded platform, game version, and NAM profile.
